Chapter 7131: Ninth Lady

Chapter 7131: Ninth Lady

She could dominate any world using her red silk alone. This was the power of a primordial immortal.

“Ninth Lady.” Everyone was surprised to see her sealing the palace.

Although this title sounded like the name of a villager, it was known across Heavenrealm. She was one of Epoch Dawn’s five primordial immortals.

Legend has it that she was a matchmaker in the mortal world. Another spoke of how she could have been a demon fox. The third possibility included her being a poor villager spurned by many, just not the dao...

Since she had made her debut long ago and was one of the few primordial immortals in Heavenrealm, no one dared inquire about her past.

However, most believed the third legend - that she was just a poor villager who made it to the top despite having mediocre talent.

“Down!” She channeled her immortal dao and pulled the strings tightly. Chaos true energy surged around the twenty-four firmaments, twisting space itself to everyone’s astonishment.

The tiny red strings began pulling Skykiller Palace, nearly causing it to fall out of the maelstrom.

Alas, the divine beasts’ palace wouldn’t fall to a single primordial immortal. The palace shook violently, but the maelstrom began channeling its suction force toward her instead.

She lost her stability despite the strings being anchored to space and firmaments.

“Down!” She shouted again and summoned her legacy. Her dao erupted like a rainbow, pulling extra power from the river of time.

“The Temporal Stone.” An immortal recognized it.

Her strings constricted tighter to the firmaments, pulling her backward along with the opposing palace. She wanted to stop the fusion between the palace and the sea of wisdom.

“Rumble!” Overlords and regular immortals watched in awe.

“Are we saved?” An overlord wondered.

“Why is she doing this?” Chongming Immortal Monarch became confused.

Divine Firmament was isolated from the outside world. Why would a member of Epoch Dawn try to stop its destruction?

“Fellow Daoist, what is the meaning of this?!” A voice came from the misty sea of wisdom.

“Death Serpent!” The monarch recognized the voice.

“Show yourself.” Her radiance swept through the world and dispelled the mist.

Cultivators then saw a draconic serpent with ancient bronze scales, issuing a sense of viscissititude. It had a pair of large wings with bony outgrowths, pointing upward with lightning currents.

It was large enough to have rivers of time flowing on its back. The temporal currents could drown any world.

“Death Serpent?!” Immortals and overlords couldn’t believe their eyes.
